evidence: Modifies FinalizePSBT in src/psbt.cpp, directly fixing the output correctness of the finalizepsbt RPC; PSBT changes without wallet code belong to rpc per category guidance.
rationale: Fixes a bug where finalizepsbt can return complete: true and an invalid raw transaction hex when inputs already contain final scripts. As noted in the description, ProduceSignature returns early without verifying pre-existing scriptSig or scriptWitness data, allowing transactions that fail mempool verification to be reported as complete.
